## Summary / 概要

<!--
Describe the change at a high level and the user problem it solves.
请简要说明这次改动，以及它解决了什么问题。
-->

## PR Type / PR 类型

- [ ] Feature / 新功能
- [ ] Bug Fix / 错误修复
- [ ] Refactor / 重构
- [ ] Docs / 文档
- [ ] Other / 其他

## Related Issue / 关联 Issue

<!--
Link the related issue here.
For feature work, please create and link a feature request issue before requesting review.
请在这里关联相关 issue。
如果是功能开发，请先创建并关联功能请求 issue，再提交 PR。

Closes #
-->

## Changes / 变更内容

<!--
List the main implementation changes.
列出本次实现的主要改动。
-->

## Root Cause or Motivation / 根因或动机

<!--
For bug fixes, explain what caused the bug.
For features, explain the motivation or user need.
对于错误修复，请说明问题根因。
对于功能开发，请说明动机或用户需求。
-->

## Validation / 验证方式

<!--
Describe how this change was tested.
For bug fixes, include how the bug was reproduced before the fix and how you confirmed it afterward.
Add commands, screenshots, or recordings if relevant.

请说明你如何验证这次改动。
如果是错误修复，请补充修复前的复现方式，以及修复后的确认方式。
如有需要，可附上命令、截图或录屏。
-->

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] I linked the related issue. / 我已关联相关 issue。
- [ ] If this is a feature, I linked a feature request issue. / 如果这是功能开发，我已关联功能请求 issue。
- [ ] I tested the change locally. / 我已在本地验证该改动。
- [ ] I considered regressions and affected workflows. / 我已考虑可能的回归和受影响流程。
- [ ] I updated docs, screenshots, or generated files if needed. / 如有需要，我已更新文档、截图或生成文件。
- [ ] This PR includes breaking changes. / 此 PR 包含破坏性变更。

## Notes / 备注

<!--
Add rollout notes, tradeoffs, known limitations, or follow-up work.
可补充发布注意事项、取舍说明、已知限制或后续工作。
-->
